findings.title: The retained import and model-recovery loop now completes on every platform
findings.observed: Exact multiline attribution context survives selection, edit, navigation, re-preview, confirmation, saved detail and material. Dirty confirmation is disabled. The correct import module is selected, the non-default model ID persists, and the same retained task reaches saved records after recovery. ZIP is a container with two child records and a correct four-record total.
findings.correction: Keep these verified transitions; extend mixed media and exceptional-state coverage without weakening the context checks.

findings.title: Closing a live invitation removes its management entry, and QR export is absent
findings.observed: Generated invitation inputs and JSON persist, expiry and cancellation are explicit, and cancellation disables transfer. After Close details and browser Back, the existing invitation is no longer displayed or reopenable; only generating a new invitation is offered. There is no Save QR image control, although it is a required contract action.
findings.correction: Retain an active invitation summary with an explicit reopen/cancel path and restore the simulated QR export path alongside JSON fallback.

findings.title: Native source status contradicts the connection and conflict state
findings.observed: Mac and Android Sources report the folder as synchronizing while native sending states that Central is unconnected and content remains local. Android preserves and resolves a source-context conflict, but the source continues to say synchronizing while the conflict is unresolved. Capture can be stopped while a prior started notice remains visible.
findings.correction: Show collection, queued sending, Central receipt and context conflict as separate current states; update the shared source summary from those same states and make affected-file holding visible.

findings.title: A text document is presented as a timed speaker transcript
findings.observed: The Markdown fixture 研究资料/记忆系统.md receives 0–6s · S1 and subsequent timed speaker segments under file processing. The manual correction and raw-text lineage work, but audio timing and speaker semantics are inappropriate for this file kind.
findings.correction: Use text extraction and text revisions for documents; expose timing, speakers and transcription controls only for suitable audio/video fixtures.

findings.title: Sources is clearer, while Library still spends attention on repeated structure
findings.observed: Native Sources now shows one source list with useful local settings links, and both native source rows are visible on a 390-pixel Android screen. Populated desktop Library still has a long second category rail. Mobile Library repeats product orientation, a title and a category heading before the first result; advanced settings expand into long task mixtures.
findings.correction: Consolidate uncommon desktop categories behind a named disclosure and shorten repeated orientation on populated screens while retaining the actual semantic controls.

findings.title: Context, privacy and account semantics improve, but the full contract is not verified
findings.observed: Web source ACK/conflict and material-precedence transitions work; switching to a second account shows an empty library; Ask reconnects and returns from citations; invalid model JSON and changed-host credential reuse are blocked. Mac permission/return, privacy-rule save and held-record release are exercised. Android send conditions block charging, metered network and low-battery cases. Many contract variations and other families remain untested, and Android resend has no eligible queue data.
findings.correction: Keep explicit partial/untested coverage, add meaningful nonempty generated queues and exercise remaining semantic journeys before any completeness claim.
